hook: Thirty days ago, Maya typed "Help me with reports." Here is what changed.
body:
This trailer follows Maya through her first month using Claude at work: the 4Ds of AI fluency, Artifacts that stop procedures vanishing into scrollback, prompts with role, context, task and format, and Projects that shrink a 300-word brief to a 50-word prompt.

It also covers memory, model choice, task decomposition, data sensitivity and catching hallucinations before they reach a board slide.

Built for anyone preparing for the Claude Certified Associate – Foundations (CCAS-F) exam, or just wanting to use Claude well at work.

🔊 Turn the sound on for the walkthrough.
